features: Five detailed local Christmas illustrations with Santa, reindeer, nutcracker, candy canes and trees.
Random reindeer and nutcracker visits: hopping, marching or peeking from either side, followed by 5–15-second hidden intervals.
improvements: Waving Santa, articulated legs and head, larger candy-cane movements, richer lights, bells, snow and ornaments.
Bounded animations with pause, reduced-motion and effects controls; unchanged 1 December–6 January calendar.
EN/DE/FR guides and release documentation updated.
fixes: Release each completed animation before starting the next visit to avoid retaining finished animations.
Preserve bundled transparent PNGs as binary files in signed update packages.
